verdict.rationale: OneDrive is fully programmable through the documented public Microsoft Graph API. First-party reference docs cover addressing items by ID or path, uploads (single-call and resumable sessions), search, sharing-link creation, versions, thumbnails, delta change tracking and change notifications. The probes found no OpenAPI spec at the generic learn.microsoft.com paths, which limits machine discoverability but does not contradict that the API exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving OneDrive through the API (beyond a passing community mention of Office using it), and a discoverable machine-readable API spec.
